records.claim: The G2/Paycom study provides reported HR/payroll evaluation practices and perceptions, not an independently reconstructable map of purchase approvals. Generic authority screening criteria do not establish individual decision rights in this study.
records.locator: Study Methodology/Respondent Roles; general methods 3.2 and5.2
records.base: 211 study interviews; mixed roles; geography/fieldwork unestablished; generic method has no separate sample
limits: Do not present as UK senior-payroll prevalence
Do not count SRC-0061 as independent corroboration
No raw participant authority traces published
records.disposition: Use for method boundary, not new market numerical claim

records.claim: ADP reports that a Purplebricks finance-transformation team built a payroll-change case and presented it to the CFO, who agreed change was needed.
records.locator: Change of ownership leads to payroll rethink; web-reader L59-63
records.base: One UK employer case, retrospective selected testimony
observed_or_reported_actions: CFO agreement on need for change
limits: CFO agreement is not proof of contract or funding approval
No prevalence or universal finance authority inference

records.claim: CIPP reports that a UK construction employer payroll manager was excluded from original provider selection, later participated in remediation review, and the CEO approved additional payroll resources after the findings.
records.locator: Scene Setting/The Action/The Results; retained text L8-20
records.base: One anonymous UK construction case; date/ownership not disclosed
limits: Do not infer exclusion caused errors
Do not identify as verified private-sector case
CEO corrective-resource approval does not identify original purchase authority

records.claim: OAHI reports that Decjuba Payroll Manager Claire Nagle led a time-and-attendance transition and her team specified requirements; a tender and her prior platform experience featured in the selection account.
records.base: One Australia-context retailer; publication 2025-12-22; event date undisclosed
limits: Tender is not evidence of procurement ownership

records.claim: The HR.com p26 EOR item asks about organisational selection criteria and does not identify who held decision authority.
records.locator: Original PDF printed p26, rendered/visually checked; method p3
records.base: Full survey 206 HR professionals, mainly North America; EOR-use subgroup/item n not displayed
limits: Do not reuse criteria proportions as role-power measures
Not direct evidence of domestic payroll platform approvals
records.disposition: Exclude from R04 authority findings; retain source-boundary note

records.claim: The inspected KPMG/UKG public page proposes stronger executive payroll ownership; this is a recommendation and not a documented employer approval case.
records.locator: The case for elevating payroll leadership
records.base: Landing page describes 319 senior-leader survey; full method/report unread
limits: No inference that a Chief Payroll Officer is prevalent or holds universal authority
records.disposition: Context only; no new current-authority finding

researcher_model_note: Pathway fields in the memo are proposed collection structure, not empirical buyer findings; do not convert them into population claims.
